name: 奉仕時間の編集
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Edit Image1 LH11-0011 v001. Fix ONLY the top-left start-time field alignment. Image2 ORIGINAL Jobber source has priority for clock geometry, proportions, optical weight, label/value alignment, spacing and fine controls. Image3 Japanese mock is secondary content guide. Original start field places CLOCK LEFT of a TWO-LINE TEXT BLOCK, vertically centered against BOTH label and value. In v001, move 「開始時刻」 horizontally RIGHT so its left edge aligns exactly with 「09:00」. Move the clock UP so its center is halfway between label and value, rather than beside value alone. Do not resize the clock. This produces source anatomy: clock on left; label over value in a coherent text column on right. Keep all other fields, controls, typography, exact copy/values, white neutral styling, borders, shadows and image geometry unchanged. 「終了時刻」「10:30」「時間」「1 時間」「分」「30 分」「備考」「受付と片付け」 stay exactly as is. Meiryo body14/24/metadata12/16regular, tracking0. No new actions, colors, icons or metrics. Raster candidate only.
reviewNotes: v002実見で原画優先の時計左/ラベル値二行右の配置へ修正を確認。09:00/10:30、1時間/30分、備考文、五欄/白/中立/切れなしを保持。原画内に選択や主要操作なし、色追加なし。正確な書体同定・実編集動作は未検証、エージェント画像レビューのみ。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。

value.description: 開始と終了、時間と分、備考を組にした編集フォーム
